远处时隐身无法被攻击，还会偷偷换道，靠近才现身。带了雇佣兵时，它现身后会锁定牧师: Stealthy and untargetable at range, it sneaks between lanes and only appears up close. With mercenaries out, it locks onto a Cleric or Mage (then an Archer) and dashes in for a one-hit kill; with no backline it heads straight for the wall. Any melee mercenary that touches it kills it.
